findings.claim: In GetWebAssets, after acquiring the write lock the code does not re-check whether entryPointAssetsCache was already populated by another goroutine. Concurrent cold-cache callers therefore each re-read and re-parse assets-manifest.json redundantly and overwrite the cache.

verifier.reason: In pkg/api/webassets/webassets.go:41-49, GetWebAssets checks entryPointAssetsCache under RLock, releases RLock, and acquires the write lock without re-checking entryPointAssetsCache. Consequently, concurrent callers that observe a nil cache before the write lock each proceed to read and parse assets-manifest.json at pkg/api/webassets/webassets.go:60 and overwrite entryPointAssetsCache at pkg/api/webassets/webassets.go:69.

coverage: pooled issues; severity and verdict are placeholders
